children: Hyatt Centric Rajpur Road Dehradun has appointed Sahil Snower as Director of Sales & Marketing, effective September 16, 2026. He brings over 20 years of hospitality experience across hotel sales, business development and commercial strategy.

Before joining Hyatt Centric Rajpur Road Dehradun, Sahil served as Cluster Director of Sales at Royal Orchid & Regenta Hotels. His experience also includes sales and business development roles at Lemon Tree Hotels, along with handling bespoke weddings and social celebrations.
In his new role, Sahil will focus on strengthening the hotel’s commercial performance and positioning the property as a destination for bespoke weddings.
He will also work on building strategic partnerships and driving business across leisure, corporate, MICE and social segments.
